items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: I took Huey's place. Huey's records had begun to do very well. So it was time for him to go on his own. I went to take his place... and it ended up in being permanent

ctx.x: Were there a lot of other musicians that, well, a lot of other people who have gone on to be great New Orleans musicians there at the time, attracted by the marching band? A few, a few, I'd say, but not super, super lucky with me. Was one of your first gigs playing with Shirley and Lee on the road alternating with Huey Smith?

Not alternating with it. I took Huey's place. Huey's records had begun to do very well. So it was time for him to go on his own. I went to take his place, whether it would be temporarily or permanent, and it ended up in being permanent, the first trip. So we weren't alternating, actually.
What do you think of Huey's influence on New Orleans music?
